name: codereviewai
description: CodeReviewAI — AI-Powered LeetCode Solution Analyzer (monorepo root)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @codereviewai/api -w @codereviewai/web -w @codereviewai/extension
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
